name: Prestidigitation
summary: Minor tricks: sparks, light or snuff a flame, clean or soil, chill or flavor, a mark, or a tiny trinket.
text: Create one of these magical effects within range (duration up to 1 hour, depending on the effect). If you cast the spell more than once, up to three of its non-instantaneous effects can be active at a time. Sensory Effect: an instant, harmless sensation such as a shower of sparks, a puff of wind, faint music or an odd smell. Fire Play: instantly light or put out a candle, a torch or a small campfire. Clean or Soil: instantly clean or dirty an object no larger than 1 cubic foot. Minor Sensation: chill, warm or flavor up to 1 cubic foot of nonliving material for 1 hour. Magic Mark: a color, small mark or symbol appears on an object or surface for 1 hour. Minor Creation: a nonmagical trinket or an illusory image that fits in your hand appears and lasts until the end of your next turn; a trinket can't deal damage and has no monetary value.
